added.summary: TSX classes for where a line may break inside a word: `hyphens-manual` (the default) breaks only at a soft hyphen, `hyphens-auto` also where the language's dictionary allows, `hyphens-none` never. They inherit like the other text classes and take variants (`md:hyphens-auto`); a game whose code writes `hyphens-auto` ships its locales' dictionaries.

fixed.summary: `text-shadow-none` on an element inside a parent with a text shadow now draws no shadow; it inherited the parent's before.
